note.summary: This chunk explains the practical mechanics of making a 'same day acquisition' election for shares (no special form, specific details required, entered via SA108 pages and computations), and how to claim relief on transfers of unlisted shares to an approved Share Incentive Plan (SIP). It also details Employee Shareholder Shares (ESS): the CGT exemption on the first £50,000 of ESS acquired, the material interest exclusion, the 16 March 2016 changes introducing a £100,000 lifetime cap for agreements from 17 March 2016, and special rules for spousal/civil partner transfers and share reorganisations involving ESS.

note.summary: HS287 explains how to calculate and report Capital Gains Tax on employee share and security schemes acquired after 31 August 2003, covering approved schemes (SIPs, SAYE, CSOP, EMI), unapproved schemes, transfers to ISAs and pension schemes, restricted/convertible shares, and same-day acquisition pooling rules. It sets out how to determine the CGT base cost of shares in various scenarios and specifies the box/code (ESH or MUL) to use on the Capital Gains Tax summary (SA108) pages. It also gives the time limit for electing to treat same-day share acquisitions as two separate categories for disposal ordering purposes.
